'''Abiss Sol'oras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who was one of the leaders of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he and guild's forces controlled the [[Old Galactic Market]]. Abiss was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a traveling hero who was [[Merchants' Guild Crisis|stopping a terrorist attack]] by the Guild.<ref name="TOR" />
